lessons.label: Pedal prerequisite

lessons.evidenceExcerpt: my A pedal takes my 5ths to 6ths, my B pedal takes my 3rds to 4ths
lessons.companionReason: The solo repeatedly engages and releases A and B while the bar moves. This lesson explains the scale-tone changes behind those pedal choices.

matches.reason: This climb keeps B down while the bar moves, then adds A. This lesson explains exactly which scale tones those pedals change.

The turnaround moves the fifth string with A, releases it, and repicks. This lesson isolates what the A pedal is doing.
